references.text: 77 Roderick St, Ipswich QLD 4305 · Jacaranda Law is an Ipswich estate planning law firm serving the South East Queensland area, with a focus on Wills and estates. We provide personalised, practical legal advice, assisting clients with estate planning, probate, estate administration, estate disputes and litigation. What sets us apart is our dedication to making the legal process smooth for our clients. Clients always deal directly with a solicitor, and we offer free initial consultations along with fixed fees for clarity and peace of mind. Meetings are available in person, via Zoom, at your home, or a location of your choice, ensuring flexibility for our clients.
